Chooses where drawing commands such as `Rect`, `Text`, [DrawImage](DrawImage) and `Plot` draw to: the back buffer, the front buffer, or the buffer of an image or texture. A program usually calls `SetBuffer BackBuffer()` once after `Graphics`. Switching the buffer puts the [Origin](Origin) and the viewport back to their defaults and the text cursor of `Print` to the top left corner.

```blitzbasic
;media still buffers/setbuffer.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local img = CreateImage(100, 100)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img)
Color 255, 160, 0
Oval 0, 0, 100, 100, 1
Color 0, 0, 0
Text 50, 50, "image", 1, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To 2
	DrawImage img, 10 + i * 100, 30 + i * 30
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```

![SetBuffer](media/buffers/setbuffer.png)
@param buffer  A buffer from [BackBuffer](BackBuffer), [FrontBuffer](FrontBuffer), [ImageBuffer](ImageBuffer) or `TextureBuffer`.
@returns BlitzPlus only: the buffer that was set before, so it can be set again later. Blitz3D gives nothing back.
@gap A debug build (`-d`) stops with an error when the buffer is the `TextureBuffer` of a texture that was not made with flag 4096 (render target), see CreateTexture.
@gap A buffer that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
